t: Titan 80-grit 125mm sanding discs are designed for dry machine sanding with orbital and random orbital sanders, to deliver consistent stock removal. The multi-material discs are ideal for decorators, carpenters and DIYers prepping plaster, wood, paint, varnish, filler, and metal, providing a medium-grit abrasive action, whilst the flexible C-weight semi-latex paper backing provides strength and flexibility. A hook and loop design ensures fast, secure attachment and easy disc changes. The pre-punched 8-hole configuration improves dust extraction, which also reduces clogging, extends sheet life and provides a cleaner working environment. Contains 5 discs
b: Compatible with Orbital & Random Orbital Sanders
Suitable for Sanding Wood, Paint & Plaster
Minimises Clogging & Heat for Longer Disc Life
Punched Design Promotes Clean Working Environments
